lines: Hungama hai kyon barpa?
couplets.en: Why all this uproar?

lines: Thodi si jo pee li hai.
Hungama hai kyon barpa, thodi si jo pee li hai?
couplets.en: I have only had a little, so why all this uproar?

lines: Daaka to nahin daala, chori to nahin ki hai.
Hungama hai kyon barpa, thodi si jo pee li hai?
couplets.en: I have robbed no one and stolen nothing, so why the uproar over a little wine?

lines: Us mai se nahin matlab, dil jis se ho begaana.
couplets.en: I have no taste for wine that estranges the heart.

lines: Us mai se nahin matlab, dil jis se ho begaana.
Maqsood hai us mai se, dil hi mein jo khinchti hai.
couplets.en: I seek the wine that is drawn into the heart itself.

lines: Suraj mein lage dhabba, fitrat ke karishme hain.
couplets.en: Even a blemish on the sun is one of nature's wonders.

lines: But hum ko kahein kaafir, Allah ki marzi hai.
couplets.en: If idols call me an unbeliever, such is God's will.

lines: Har zarra chamakta hai, anwaar-e-ilaahi se.
